answer: Correct-dissent bonuses resist sybil grading rings: a grader who breaks from the majority and is later proven right earns an outsized reward, so honest graders are paid to expose a colluding bloc rather than conform to it. A ring that spirals its members toward one coordinated score creates exactly the wrong majority a dissenter can profit by overturning — the lotus of false consensus is forced open at the forge of appeal. Rewarding correct minority reports means a cartel cannot rely on conformity; every honest outsider holds a bounty to break it.
